steps.title: Tasks table
steps.hint: Browse and preview recordings here before you annotate.

steps.title: Move with ↑ ↓
steps.hint: The highlighted row moves and the list scrolls with it.

steps.title: Open a preview
steps.hint: Click a row to open its spectrogram preview. Click again to close it.

steps.title: Pin previews
steps.hint: Pin up to 5 previews to compare tasks side by side.

steps.title: All shortcuts
steps.hint: Shift ticks rows, dragging selects several. Bulk actions and every shortcut are listed here.
steps.task: Press ? to open the shortcut list

steps.title: Back to Annotate
steps.hint: The lessons continue on the Annotate tab.

steps.title: Project progress
steps.hint: Total, done and remaining tasks.

steps.title: Recording info
steps.hint: File, site, date and samplerate of this recording.

steps.title: Spectrogram
steps.hint: You will spend most of your time here.

steps.title: Event details
steps.hint: Details of the selected sound event appear here.

steps.title: Sound event tags
steps.hint: All tags used by sound events in this task.

steps.title: Task tags
steps.hint: Tags that describe the whole recording.

steps.title: Status badges
steps.hint: A badge finishes the task and opens the next one. In this tour, each task is one lesson.
steps.task: Give this task any status badge

steps.title: Drag to pan
steps.hint: Click and drag the spectrogram. Trackpad scroll gestures work too.

steps.title: Overview strip
steps.hint: The highlighted window marks what you see above. Drag it or click to jump.

steps.title: Arrow keys
steps.hint: Arrows move time and frequency. Shift + ← / → switches tasks.

steps.hint: Turns on box zoom.

steps.title: Box zoom
steps.hint: With zoom mode on, drag a rectangle around a call.

steps.title: Step zoom
steps.hint: Zoom time in or out. Add Ctrl to zoom frequency.

steps.title: Reset
steps.hint: Back to the full task window.

steps.hint: Look at the raw spectrogram without boxes.

steps.title: Create
steps.hint: Activate create mode, then draw a box on the spectrogram.

steps.title: Select
steps.hint: Select mode lets you click an event. Resize it with its handles, Esc deselects.

steps.title: Details
steps.hint: Tags, measurements and a zoomed view of the selected event.

steps.title: Jump between events
steps.hint: Cycle through events without the mouse.

steps.title: Delete
steps.hint: One event here is mislabeled. Delete mode removes events, or press x while one is selected.

steps.title: Next lesson
steps.task: Give this task any status badge

steps.title: Remove a wrong tag
steps.hint: Select the event tagged “this: is wrong” and remove that tag.
steps.task: Remove a tag from a sound event

steps.title: Add a species
steps.hint: Add the correct species to the same event.
steps.task: Add a tag to a sound event

steps.title: Bulk tag actions
steps.hint: Replace a tag on every event at once (r), or tag all untagged events (a).

steps.title: Task tags
steps.hint: Tags for the whole recording, e.g. noise or recording quality.

steps.title: Next lesson
steps.task: Give this task any status badge

steps.title: Play
steps.hint: Audio is time-expanded according to the speed setting.

steps.title: Speed
steps.hint: Slower speeds make ultrasonic calls audible.

steps.title: Repeat & autoplay
steps.hint: Loop the window, or start playing automatically on every task.

steps.title: Seek
steps.hint: Double-click the spectrogram where playback should start.

steps.title: Next lesson
steps.task: Give this task any status badge

steps.title: Filters
steps.hint: Filter by status, tags, date and more. “Pending” shows tasks without a final badge.

steps.title: Finish the remaining tasks
steps.hint: Annotate and badge each remaining recording on your own.
steps.task: Give this task any status badge

steps.title: Tour complete
steps.hint: You can restart the tour anytime from the home page.

steps.title: Create
steps.hint: Activate create mode, then draw a box on the spectrogram. The new event is selected right away.

steps.title: Details
steps.hint: A preview, tags and technical details of the selected event. Events created by an AI model also show their confidence.

steps.title: Deselect
steps.hint: Escape clears the selection.

steps.title: Select
steps.hint: Activate select mode, then click an event.

steps.title: Resize
steps.hint: Grab one of the little squares on the selected event and drag it.
steps.task: Make an event bigger or smaller

steps.title: Jump between events
steps.hint: No scrolling through long files. Cycle through events with the keyboard.

steps.title: Delete
steps.hint: One event in this recording is mislabeled “this: is wrong”. Jump to it and delete it: activate delete mode and click it, or press x with it selected. Ctrl + Z undoes a deletion.

steps.title: Next lesson
steps.task: Give this task any status badge

steps.title: Remove a wrong tag
steps.hint: One event is tagged “this: is wrong”. Select it and remove that tag: click the tag, or press d for a picker.
steps.task: Remove a tag from a sound event

steps.title: Add the right tag
steps.hint: Add a fitting species. Click “Add tags” or the + next to the event. Suggestions appear as you type.
steps.task: Add a tag to a sound event

steps.title: Task tags
steps.hint: Tags for the whole recording, e.g. when a file only holds noise or insects.

steps.title: Next lesson
steps.task: Give this task any status badge

steps.title: Listen first
steps.hint: One event is tagged Graureiher (grey heron, Ardea cinerea). Play the recording and see whether you can hear it.

steps.title: Replace a tag
steps.hint: Replace combines delete and add. Select the Graureiher event, then replace its tag with “this: is wrong”. Try searching for “replace”.

steps.title: All events at once
steps.hint: Add, delete and replace work on every event of the recording when none is selected. Deselect first when you only mean one. Ctrl + Z undoes it.

steps.title: Next lesson
steps.task: Give this task any status badge

steps.title: Play
steps.hint: The player has play/pause, repeat, autoplay, a progress bar and the speed.

steps.title: Seek
steps.hint: Double-click the spectrogram where playback should start. A red marker shows the position.

steps.title: Repeat & autoplay
steps.hint: Repeat loops the window. Autoplay starts every task you open.

steps.title: Play one event
steps.hint: With a sound event selected, the player plays only that event.

steps.title: Speed
steps.hint: Sonari picks a speed from the samplerate. Real time for birds, much slower for bats. Change it any time.

steps.title: Next lesson
steps.task: Give this task any status badge

steps.title: Filters
steps.hint: Filter by date, time, station, tag or status badge. Choose “Pending” and “include” to see only tasks without a final badge.

steps.title: Annotate on your own
steps.hint: Use everything you learned on the next recording.
steps.task: Give this task any status badge

steps.title: Tour complete
steps.hint: Finish the remaining recordings so each has a status badge. You can restart the tour anytime from the home page.
